title: SAL-DSC-10 Discount
summary: SAL-DSC-10 records and maintains customer trade discount schedules via services dsc_get, dsc_save, and dsc_search.
body:
Screen SAL-DSC-10 records and maintains commercial discount terms with individual trade accounts in Ledgerline [^r1]. It is accessed via the menu path Sales > Discount by users assigned to the SAL-EXEC, SAL-MGR, or SYS-ADMIN roles [^r1][^r7]. The screen interacts directly with the [[services-sal-dsc|SAL dsc services]] dsc_get, dsc_save, and dsc_search to query, validate, and store customer discounts [^r1][^r7].

## Fields

The screen layout contains five fields used to establish customer discount parameters [^r2]:

| Field | Description | Mandatory / Optional |
|---|---|---|
| DSC CD | Discount schedule identifier (`dsc_cd`) [^r2][^r7] | Mandatory [^r2][^r7] |
| CUST CD | Customer account identifier (`cust_cd`) [^r2][^r7] | Mandatory [^r2][^r7] |
| DISC % | Percentage deduction (`dsc_pct`) [^r2][^r7] | Mandatory [^r2][^r7] |
| VALID TO | Validity end date (`valid_to`) [^r2][^r7] | Optional [^r2][^r7] |
| STATUS | Operational state (`status`) [^r2][^r7] | Optional [^r2][^r7] |

## Keys and services

SAL-DSC-10 links standard function keys to background sales discount services [^r8]:

* **Search (`F2`/`Enter`)**: Calls the read service `dsc_search` (DISCOUNT LIST) to open an inquiry window displaying existing discount schedules and associated customer references [^r3][^r8][^r11]. Results can be filtered optionally by CUST CD, DISC %, VALID TO, and STATUS [^r11].
* **Get (`F3`)**: Invokes the read service `dsc_get` (DISCOUNT GET) using the parameter `dsc_cd` to populate stored record values into CUST CD, DISC %, VALID TO, and STATUS [^r4][^r8][^r9].
* **Save (`F8`)**: Triggers the write service `dsc_save` (DISCOUNT SAVE) using fields `cust_cd`, `dsc_pct`, and optional `valid_to` to validate entries against the customer ledger and commit terms to core tables [^r5][^r8][^r10].

## Messages

The screen raises validation errors when account verification fails [^r6][^r8]:

* [[err-dsc-0001|ERR-DSC-0001]]: Displayed when customer account rules fail or if the targeted customer account is marked on stop, halting the transaction [^r6][^r8].

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: The SAL-DSC-10 screen presents five principal data entry and display fields arranged across the main maintenance pane: • DSC CD: The discount schedule identifier.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r3.section: Step by step: Searching for an existing discount record
r3.loc_text: p. 38, Step by step: Searching for an existing discount record
r3.quote: Press the dsc_search button to call the DISCOUNT LIST service. • The system presents an inquiry overlay listing current discount records, displaying the discount code alongside the linked customer reference.

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r4.section: Step by step: Retrieving and viewing a discount record
r4.loc_text: p. 39, Step by step: Retrieving and viewing a discount record
r4.quote: Press the dsc_get button to initiate the DISCOUNT GET service. • Ledgerline ERP 7.2 reads the central pricing files and automatically fills the remaining fields on the screen: CUST CD, DISC %, VALID TO, and STATUS.

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: dsc_save: Invokes the DISCOUNT SAVE service. This routine validates all current screen entries, applies integrity checks against the customer ledger, and commits new or modified commercial discount terms

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r6.quote: If the customer account cannot accept the specified rate, or if the account is currently marked on stop, Ledgerline rejects the transaction and displays ERR-DSC-0001 on the message line.

r7.quote: SAL-DSC-10 DISCOUNT Menu: Sales > Discount. Roles: [SAL-EXEC, SAL-MGR, SYS-ADMIN].

r8.quote: Get F3 dsc_get Save F8 dsc_save Search F2/Enter dsc_search

service: dsc_get
title: DISCOUNT GET
module: SAL
kind: read
screen: SAL-DSC-10

r10.quote: service: dsc_save title: DISCOUNT SAVE module: SAL kind: write screen: SAL-DSC-10

r11.quote: service: dsc_search title: DISCOUNT LIST module: SAL kind: read screen: SAL-DSC-10
